@June, Gideon closed **ticket #8841** with support on 1 Jul, 09:17. He said the fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard report template worked for their billing team.

One caution: a 30 Sep strategic digest in the knowledge base describes #8841 differently, as a Door 14 kiosk selection bug escalated to platform engineering. I can't tell from here which is right, so check the ticket itself before you rely on either description.
